contract.probe: One private own-CE SGD step at fixed shared theta
contract.cost: Finite S softplus class-competitor margin change; member centered and smoothly pair scaled
contract.allocation: Both directions of every unordered class pair; exactly eight feasible tangent-projected descent steps with positive row-simplex/equal member mass and graph/entropy energy
contract.private_derivative: Q independent input to partial private gradient
contract.outer_derivative: Shared theta receives total response/normalization/finite Q-map derivative
contract.query: Disjoint R supplies TRAIN own+probability-pool CE supervision
contract.commit: Shared SGD then recompute whole response/Q/private step from original persistent private state; discard virtual states
contract.qualification: A excluded from all acquisition and S/R losses/selection; never R
